name: @yuance/desktop
description: 元策桌面端 Electron 壳
author: 元策

scripts.check:native: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/file-guard/Cargo.toml --check && cargo test --manifest-path native/file-guard/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:network: node ./scripts/check-sources.mjs src/network/operation-registry.mjs src/network/attachment-operation-registry.mjs src/network/response-contract.mjs src/network/rest-transport.mjs src/network/sse-client.mjs src/network/public-network-state.mjs src/network/network-coordinator.mjs src/network/power-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.check:smoke: node ./scripts/check-sources.mjs scripts/smoke-desktop-network.mjs scripts/verify-desktop-network-artifacts.mjs scripts/smoke-desktop-file-transfer.mjs scripts/verify-desktop-file-transfer-artifacts.mjs scripts/smoke-desktop-business-file.mjs scripts/verify-desktop-business-file-artifacts.mjs scripts/smoke-desktop-feature-parity.mjs scripts/verify-desktop-feature-parity-artifacts.mjs test/support/real-api-fixture.mjs test/support/browser-approval-driver.mjs test/support/network-session-electron-driver.mjs test/download-electron-integration.test.mjs test/desktop-business-api-integration.test.mjs test/desktop-business-file-integration.test.mjs test/desktop-feature-parity-electron-integration.test.mjs
scripts.check:renderer: node ./scripts/assert-renderer-source.mjs && tsc -p jsconfig.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsconfig.renderer.tsbuildinfo && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.eslintcache "src/renderer/**/*.{js,jsx}" "test/renderer-*.test.mjs" vite.config.js eslint.config.js && npm run build:renderer
scripts.check: npm run check:native && npm run check:reveal && npm run check:business-file && npm run check:notifications && npm run check:main && npm run check:ipc && npm run check:network && npm run check:smoke && npm run check:renderer
scripts.dist:ci: npm run build:native && npm run check && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:native && npm run check && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win
